decision: Most of your products are low-risk under the EU AI Act. Your obligations are Article 50 transparency: tell users they're talking to AI, and machine-mark AI-generated media. Avoid Annex III uses (hiring, credit, medical triage) unless you're ready for high-risk duties from Dec 2027. Flow down the model providers' usage policies in your ToS.
details: Sources conflict on the content-labelling grace period; verify against Regulation 2026/1744 and with a lawyer.

verify.note: Common Paper AI Addendum v1.0 is CC BY 4.0 (confirmed). Addleshaw Goddard (1 Jul 2026) says the AI Omnibus was adopted: Art. 50 applies from 2 Aug 2026 with grace to 2 Dec 2026 for systems already on the market; Annex III high-risk moves to 2 Dec 2027, Annex I (product-embedded, e.g. medical-device software) to 2 Aug 2028. Add that healthcare AI that is a medical device falls under the Aug 2028 Annex I date. Regulation number 2026/1744 not confirmed.
